main.description: IVF semantic search across vessel / legal-entity / spatial names. Embeds the query via Cloudflare Workers AI (@cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5, 768-dim) → cosine-distance vs ~128 centroids in vertex_ivf_centroid (collection='maps_search_v1') → top-4 cluster scan in vertex_vector_embedding_768 (space_id='maps_search_v1') → cosine-similarity sort. Returns indexed=false when no centroids exist (backfill not yet run). ADR-2605011500 §Phase-1.3.

query.description: Free-text query, ≥2 chars. Will be embedded with bge-base-en-v1.5 (works for English + Latin-script Japanese romaji).

nodes.description: Array of { id (source vertex_id), title, similarity (cosine, 0-1) } sorted descending by similarity.

indexed.description: false when no centroids exist (need backfill); client should fall back to keyword search.
